frozen.title: Waiting on design: commodity search lists results as the trader types, in both animals sets, once commodities come from MDM
frozen.detail: The commodity search lists results as the trader types, behind an icon search button, announces results and selections in a polite live region, and keeps the typed text open for more ticks, with Escape closing the results. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps today's server-side search, which already works without JavaScript, and holds this behaviour until design answers its question about search as you type; it is also held until commodities come from MDM. When both have happened it is built as design says with an accepted component, or dropped if design drops it. This is the live-animals half of the row; the germinal set's copy of the same behaviour is the germinal-products area's draft for it. The germinal commodity search is to list matching commodities as the trader types, each with its code and species, and announce the number of results. The behaviour waits twice over: on design's answer about search as you type, and on the germinal catalogue, which is drawn from the central commodity list. When both are settled it is built as design says, or dropped if design drops it.

frozen.title: With JavaScript, transit countries are added as they are picked and removed in place, announced as 'Added' and 'Removed'

With JavaScript the picked country joins the list of added countries straight away, Remove takes one off without reloading the page, and a screen reader hears 'Added <country>' and 'Removed <country>'. Without JavaScript the page keeps working exactly as it does today, so this enhancement waits: design must say whether adding on pick, removing without a page load and the 'Added'/'Removed' wording are strongly needed and which tested library should provide them. It is built as design says, or dropped if design drops it. However it is built, the saved answer stays a list of country codes and every check on the transit list stays.

frozen.title: 'Information is missing' on the live animals notification list card when animal identifiers are incomplete
frozen.detail: A trader who submitted a notification with its certificate but without all the animal identifiers it needs has nothing on the list to tell them so. The card now shows that information is missing, worked out from what the notification recorded at submit. A commodity line whose species asks for identifiers is incomplete when it holds fewer identified animal records than the animals it declares, and a record counts as identified once one of its identifiers is filled, so a single-species consignment with no identifier saved counts as incomplete. A trader is told on the list what still needs doing on a submitted notification that has items outstanding. The card carries the outstanding item as plain text under the reference, taken from what the record stored when the notification was submitted, with the missing certificate named first and incomplete identifiers next.

frozen.title: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own pages, saved, listed, changed and used to start a germinal products notification
frozen.detail: Template creation offers Germinal products alongside Live animals, because a template carries its type and the service that stores templates holds both animals sets. A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode — the same template mode the live animals pages use, applied to the germinal pages, never a copied template journey — so it has no Additional details task and asks no CPH number or permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed one section at a time and deleted like any template. Using it starts a germinal products notification seeded only with the answers that fit that set: the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature when it is one of the germinal products temperature options. 'Certified for' is the germinal set's fixed 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded. Both save buttons on a germinal template page make exactly the same checks, as they do everywhere else.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing 'Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos)' on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's first question page in template mode, with the 'Template' caption and the template's name. frozen.title: The journey tells a hard stop from a submission check, and keeps a group of answers all-or-nothing
frozen.detail: The notification's data specification marks each answer as mandatory to proceed, mandatory to submit, optional or conditional, and marks some answers as a group that is filled in together. The journey's obligation model carries only mandatory or optional today, and a mandatory answer is held back to the submission check while each page's own hard stops are written into the page, so the two kinds of mandatory cannot be told apart and a half-filled group can be stored. After this row the model carries all four markings and the all-or-nothing group, and judges each one where the answer applies: on the notification, on a commodity line or on a unit. A trader is then stopped on the page only by an answer the specification makes a hard stop, is told at submission about an answer that only holds submission back, and can never store half of a group. The high-risk plants journey shares the model and takes the same change.
acceptanceCriteria: An answer the notification data specification marks mandatory to proceed must be given before its page can be left: every save control the page offers refuses a blank answer with an error naming it in the error summary and inline, the trader stays on the page with what they entered still shown, and nothing is saved. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-011, confluence-6497338582-p1-011-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-140, repo-frontend-p2-171)

An answer the specification marks mandatory to submit can be left blank while the notification is being filled in, so every save control on its page saves and moves on with it blank, and the notification cannot be submitted until it is given, with each one still missing named when the trader tries to submit. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-140)

An answer the specification marks optional can be left blank throughout: its page saves and moves on without it, and the notification submits without it. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-171)

An answer the specification marks conditional is needed only while its stated condition holds, judged at the level the answer applies at, so the same answer can be needed for one commodity line and not for another on the same notification, and needed for one unit and not another on the same line. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-016; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-143)

A group of answers the specification marks all-or-nothing can be left blank as a whole, and once any answer in the group is given every save control the page offers refuses it with an error for each answer still missing from that group. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-015, confluence-6497338582-p1-011-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-004)

The overview task row covering an all-or-nothing group reads 'Complete' when every answer in the group is given and when none of them is, and reads as still to do while only part of the group is given. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-160, repo-frontend-p2-159-m1)

The high-risk plants journey judges its own answers by the same four markings and the same all-or-nothing rule, with the same wording on the page and the same reading on its overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 43 and 44)
